title: Joint Latent Reasoning and Observation for Agentic Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.35229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective video agents must learn not only how to answer, but also where to look next. Transferring this capability to smaller models is challenging because each observation serves two purposes: supporting an answer and guiding the search for further evidence. Textual descriptions may capture what is currently visible while omitting cues needed for subsequent acquisition. We introduce Latent Agentic Reasoning for Video Analysis (LARVA), a framework that distills multi-round video agents through jointly learned latent reasoning and visual observations. Rather than communicating through captions, an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner that selects the next acquisition action or produces the final answer. Crucially, action and answer supervision propagate through this interface, training the observer to communicate information useful for downstream decisions. translated_title: 联合潜在推理与观察的智能体视频理解
translated_abstract: 有效的视频智能体不仅要学会如何回答问题，还必须学会下一步该观察什么。将这种能力迁移到更小的模型上极具挑战性，因为每次观察都承担着双重目的：既要支持答案生成，又要引导对后续证据的搜索。文本描述可能只捕捉当前可见的内容，而遗漏了后续信息获取所需的线索。我们提出了面向视频分析的潜在智能体推理框架（LARVA），该框架通过联合学习的潜在推理与视觉观察来蒸馏多轮视频智能体。观察者不再通过字幕进行交流，而是将紧凑的连续表示传递给推理器，由推理器选择下一个信息获取动作或生成最终答案。至关重要的是，动作与答案的监督信号通过该接口传播，从而训练观察者传递对下游决策有用的信息。观察重建与推理分布（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出LARVA框架，通过联合学习潜在推理与视觉观察将多轮视频智能体蒸馏到更小的模型中，观察者以紧凑连续表示与推理器交互，并由动作与答案双重监督训练其传递有利于下游决策的信息。
en_tdlr: LARVA distills multi-round video agents into smaller models by jointly learning latent reasoning and visual observation, where an observer passes compact continuous representations to a reasoner and is trained by both action and answer supervision to convey information useful for downstream decisions.
